drums.tags: Industrial techno. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a heavy, saturated low-end pulse at 135 BPM in the key of F minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and high-pass filtering plays a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. A white noise snare with a gated reverb hits on beats 2 and 4. A high-pitched, resonant acid synth line enters with automated filter cutoff and resonance sweeps. Industrial foley textures and metallic clangs are processed with rhythmic delay and bit-crushing. The arrangement features a breakdown with a low-pass filter sweep on the master bus before a sudden drop back into the full percussive groove.

bass.tags: A dry, isolated drum kit performance in a rock style. The kit consists of a kick drum, snare, hi-hats, and a crash cymbal. The pattern features a steady eighth-note hi-hat pulse with a syncopated kick drum pattern that emphasizes the downbeat and the 'and' of beat 2. The snare hits are consistent backbeats on 2 and 4. The recording is dry with minimal room ambience and no artificial reverb. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
